title: Beautiful But Heavy 12” Skillet Needs Lots of Storage Space
text:
Beautiful But Heavy 12” Skillet Needs Lots of Storage Space. This CALPHALON PREMIER SPACE SAVING NONSTICK 5QT SAUTE PAN WITH COVER is a beautiful nonstick cookware item. It’s a capacious 12” skillet (12½” across the top, with 2½” sides) made of heavyweight hard anodized aluminum. The two handles are stainless steel, which stays cool when you’re cooking on a stovetop (gas, electric, glass top). The hard nonstick surface is okay with metal utensils.

The space-saving claim is somewhat exaggerated, because it refers to the skillet’s ability to stack VERTICALLY with other cookware (with the same 12” diameter) from the “Calphalon Premier Space Saving” series. In fact, this very large and heavy 12” skillet consumes a lot of horizontal storage space, because it measures 23½” from the handle on the left to the tip of the long (primary) handle on the right. The skillet is almost two feet wide! If your plan is to buy several 12” diameter pieces from the series and stack them, don’t forget to calculate the total stack height to make sure it will fit in your storage area.

The tempered glass cover is flat (for vertical-space-saving stacking) rather than domed like most glass skillet lids (which may or may not store upside down in their skillets). The flat glass cover takes a little getting used to, if you’re accustomed to domed covers, and it is NOT vented. The glass cover has its own long stainless steel handle, which adds to the substantial total weight of the skillet plus cover.

The skillet is oven safe to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. (My kitchen has a rule against using long-handled cookware in the oven. I take it out of the oven with a hotpad, set it down somewhere, and burn myself every time by forgetting that the normally cool handle is still oven-hot.) The skillet is quite heavy when empty; I need to use two hands to handle it safely when it is filled with food or covered with the lid.

The skillet is dishwasher safe. However, the dark gray exterior may bleach out to a streaky lighter gray if you wash it regularly in a dishwasher—this is what happened with my Classic Calphalon anodized aluminum cookware. If you have a glass or ceramic cooktop, be sure NOT to preheat the skillet on high heat, or to heat it empty.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Premier Space-Saving Hard-Anodized Nonstick 5-Quart Saute Pan with Lid
features: Stacks neatly and nests in any order, saving up to 30% more space
Built to last, with MineralShield nonstick technology that’s 5x more durable than before (vs. previous generation of Calphalon Classic)
Metal-utensil-safe with a long-lasting, 3-layer nonstick interior
Oven-safe up to 450 degrees F, so you can easily go from stovetop to oven
Compatible with most stovetops, including gas, electric, and glass
description: Featuring MineralShield nonstick technology, Calphalon Premier Space-Saving Hard-Anodized Nonstick Cookware is now 5x more durable than before when compared to the previous generation of Calphalon Classic. This nonstick saute pan delivers long-lasting performance for effortless food release, so you can cook with confidence and serve even the most delicate food with ease. This space-saving line also securely stacks to save 30% more space than its non-stacking counterparts. Thanks to their unique design and flat glass covers, the pots and pans stack and nest in any order when stored on other items of the same diameter. A 3-layer nonstick interior is made with some of the Earth's hardest minerals to withstand metal utensils and everyday use and the hard-anodized exterior is dishwasher-safe for easy cleanup. They are oven-safe up to 450 degrees F, able to go from the stovetop into the oven for heating and cooking versatility. Elevate your cooking experience with Calphalon Premier, and enjoy exceptional performance with endless possibilities.
